review.title: Route review
review.summary.none: No deviations: you walked the approved plan.
review.summary.no.plan: No approved plan was recorded, so there is nothing to compare the walk with.
review.reason.reserve: The margin fell to {margin} near {near}, under the reserve
review.reason.late.event: Still off the route when this alert started: {event}
review.reason.event: Alert active when you left the route: {event}
review.reason.replan.slope: Followed the slope detour planned at {time}
review.reason.replan.event: Followed the hazard re-route planned at {time}
review.reason.sample.one: Secured a sample with {margin} of margin
review.reason.none: No find, sample or alert: {distance} walked off the plan
review.open: Still off the plan when the EVA ended
review.reason.find.alert: Went to find {label}, added on a GO card, with {margin} of margin; this alert started on the way: {event}
review.none.detail: The walk never left the approved plan by more than {enter} m for {length} m or longer, so the two lines overlap on the map.
review.map.title: Approved plan and walked track
review.strip.title: Margin over the reserve
review.strip.label: Margin over the reserve from {start} to {end}; lowest {low} at {at}
review.notes.deviation: A deviation starts when you are more than {enter} m from the plan approved at Begin EVA and lasts at least {length} m of walking; it ends when you are back within {exit} m. Re-plans during the EVA do not move the plan it is judged against.
review.notes.cost: Costs compare the walked stretch with the stretch of the plan it replaced: time from the mission clock and oxygen from the suit model, against the plan's per-leg costs.
review.notes.worth: you marked a find or secured a sample in it, and the margin stayed above the reserve.
review.notes.forced: a hazard alert (dust storm, radiation or low oxygen) was active when it started, or it follows a slope detour or hazard re-route the system planned. A correct reaction, not a mistake.
review.notes.risky: it crossed ground at or above {slope}°, the margin went under the {reserve} min reserve, or you were still off the route when an alert started, unless you were on the way to a find you added while its card read GO.
review.notes.risky.short: it crossed ground at or above {slope}°, the margin went under the reserve, or you were still off the route when an alert started, unless you were on the way to a find you added while its card read GO.
review.notes.costly: none of the above, so it spent time and oxygen for nothing.
review.notes.order: when several rules fit, the first in this order decides: ground at or above {slope}° (risky); an alert or a system re-plan when it started (forced); the margin under the reserve, or an alert that started while you were off the route, except on the way to a find added on a GO card (risky); a find or a sample (worth it); otherwise costly. A sample never excuses a no-go slope, and a forced detour stays forced when the margin drops under the reserve or a second alert starts during it.
